question: How rare is true knowledge of the Lord?
premises: among thousands one strives for perfection
among accomplished ones one knows him truly
inference: True knowledge of the Lord is rare and effort-worthy.
uncertainties: fused commentary tokens analyzed as given
plain_english: Among thousands of men someone strives for perfection; among strivers and accomplished ones someone knows me in truth. By this, all are not fit for this thing, because of its rarity; effort-worthy knowledge is declared.
